reason: I have one or two chairs and I'm standing at one of them all day, so I already know who's in the chair and what's in the drawer. The WhatsApp reminders and wallet look cool, but ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month is a lot for a shop my size that runs fine on a notebook and UPI.
objection: Most of this app is built for watching staff I'm already sitting next to, and making my one guy take a selfie to check in will feel like I don't trust him. I'd be paying for features I don't need.
would_change_my_mind: A small-shop plan with no setup fee and only the customer side (WhatsApp reminders, prepaid wallet, referral reward) for around ₹299-399 a month, no selfie check-in.
